annotations.title: How the railway did on a day

description: TransitRadar's own record of one completed day on GB passenger rail: how many trains ran, how many were cancelled, the share of RECORDED arrivals within five minutes at their destination, the same share counting each cancellation as a failure, per-operator figures, and the commonest delay and cancellation reasons. Measured at the destination, so it is stricter than, and not comparable with, the industry's published PPM. Available from 2026-08-06 up to yesterday; where fewer than half of arrivals were recorded, no punctuality figure is given.

operators.description: How many operators to include, largest first, 1-40.
